headline: Orient Technologies sets November 13 as dividend record date
hook: Dividend payout confirmed for Orient Technologies
summary: Orient Technologies has officially declared November 13, 2026, as the record date for its upcoming dividend payment. Shareholders listed in the company's records by this date will be eligible to receive the dividend. This announcement follows the company's standard corporate action procedures.
whats_next: Dividend payment date to be announced
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders will receive the declared dividend payout.

headline: Orient Technologies releases investor presentation
hook: Routine corporate update from Orient Technologies
summary: Orient Technologies Limited has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. The document provides strategic updates and operational details for the company. Such presentations help retail and institutional shareholders track business progress between quarterly earnings. The disclosure is a routine filing with no immediate financial impact on stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Provides insight into company strategy without direct valuation impact.

headline: Orient Technologies reports strong Q2 FY27 profit and declares 20% interim dividend
hook: Higher margins drive Q2 profit growth
summary: Orient Technologies has announced its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, highlighting strong profitability driven by an increased contribution from managed services. Alongside the earnings report, the company's board of directors declared an interim dividend of 20% of the face value per share. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from both improved operational profitability and an immediate cash payout. The quarterly results offer insight into the company's execution in high-margin IT service segments.
why_it_matters: Interim dividend payout and higher margins reward existing shareholders.

headline: Orient Technologies declares Rs 2 interim dividend with Q2 results
summary: Orient Technologies released its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The board also declared an interim dividend of Rs 2 per equity share, representing 20 percent of its face value of Rs 10. The record date for determining eligible shareholders to receive this dividend is Friday, November 13, 2026. Payment will be distributed to eligible shareholders within 30 days of declaration.
whats_next: November 13, 2026 record date for dividend eligibility
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders receive a cash payout by mid-December 2026.

headline: Orient Technologies updates insider trading regulations framework
hook: Updated insider trading norms at Orient Tech
summary: Orient Technologies Limited has submitted an intimation to the exchange regarding an update to its code of practices and procedures for fair disclosure of unpublished price sensitive information. The update is made under Regulation 8(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. Such periodic updates ensure compliance with evolving capital market regulations. For Indian retail investors, this is a routine corporate governance filing with no immediate impact on stock price or company operations.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact.
